summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness vision plugin that provides image analysis, OCR, grounding, detection, and color tools, with image input via local paths and paste-to-path image handling.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is primarily a media-processing extension for DeepSeek Harness, focused on vision capabilities rather than general project tooling or orchestration. It exposes a runtime `vision` skill plus multiple image tools for analysis, OCR, grounding, detection, and color extraction, with path-based image input and web paste-to-path handling. Evidence from README and package metadata confirms external multimodal API usage, local image OCR fallback, and DSH plugin/client bundle integration, so classification is centered on media tools with moderate integration risk from optional external calls and file/image handling.
